items.text: We’re pleased to announce that additional cross-play features for Poker Club are arriving today in a new update!

Poker Club players on Steam will now be able to play seamlessly with friends on Epic Games. For multiplayer matchmaking, you’ll find a larger pool of players to connect with across both Steam and Epic Games.
This update also includes performance and optimisation improvements.
Please note: as a result of the update, there may be some downtime for Poker Club until around 9 PM GMT today.
We hope you enjoy it, and thanks as always for your support!

releases.displayName: Coming Tomorrow: Cross-play with Epic Games

items.text: A new update will allow Poker Club players on Steam to play with friends on Epic Games for the first time.
The update will also include performance and optimisation improvements, as well as fixes for some recently reported issues.
The update will take place on Thursday 27/04/23 between 1 PM - 9 PM GMT.
Please note: As a result of the update, there may be some downtime for Poker Club during this time.
We hope you enjoy it, and thanks as always for your support!
The Ripstone Team
The Tournaments update is now available to download for Poker Club on PC and Xbox platforms. The Tournaments update includes:
Come together each month in a highly contested, winner-takes-all competition.
Each tournament features a unique theme, with decorated environments and soundscapes.
Three brand new cosmetic items to earn in every tournament, including standout table items and clothing.
Winners will be immortalised in the “Hall of Fame” a leaderboard specifically tracking tournament victors.

The first of our monthly tournaments, Blackjack’s Treasure Hoard is a pirate-themed event taking place in the Casino D’Oro. We’ve packed out the venue with what’s left of his crew who’ll get you into the spirit with their selection of sea shanties. Can you be the first to get your hands on the hoard and earn your place in the Hall of Fame?
Pick up your free bundle and show everyone at the table that with 100k extra chips in your bag and your new hat, you don’t give a cluck.
Boost your balance with a selection of chip packs with the brand new chip store.
Browse a range of heavily discounted bundles for a burst of additional chips as well as some glorious shining gold cosmetics.

It’s really important to us that our players have the best possible experience when playing Poker Club. Listening to all of your feedback, we understand that one of the biggest factors in this is having as many players as possible at the table.
To help with this we are dropping the price of Poker Club to £15.99/$19.99 So if you have friends who were thinking about picking it up, now is the perfect chance to get them involved!

As part of this update, everyone who already has a Poker Club account will receive a special Founders Bundle sent directly to their account. This contains a unique, never to be seen again item marking you as a “Legend” and founder of the game, as well as another hefty boost to your chip balance.
Improved spectator mode allowing the spectator host to easily see all cards in the game and cycle between players perspectives.
In-game messaging improvements via splash screens.
Improvements to tournament UI.
Improvements to rewards screens.
Bug fixes and stability improvements.
This hotfix fixes an issue that could cause the game to crash
The River update is now available to download for Poker Club on PC, Playstation and Xbox platforms. The River update includes:
We’re making sure that every showdown is exciting, keeping you immersed as the tension builds up and the winning cards are revealed!
Improved matchmaking across all events, including PCC Tour.
AI will now give up a seat at a cash table whenever a new player joins.
Invite codes for every table, meaning that you can easily fill the extra seats
New custom game features giving you the tools to create your own events, with or without bots.
We’ll also be trialling new events with no AI at the table, so make sure to get involved and let us know what you think!
Invite players directly from your friends list on Steam and Xbox platforms. We’re also aiming to add Playstation in the near future.
Choose to spectate or join the table yourself.
Access to more spectator options, including the ability to see all hole cards at any time.
Complete control over when the tournament starts for hosts.

We will now be registering interest for our Community Prize Program. This will aim to support players who are hosting events, rewarding both the winning players and those who are putting in the time to help build on our amazing Poker Club community.

Head down to our newest Poker venue, the Manor House. A sophisticated setting, dressed in the ornately detailed mahogany furnishings of a princely estate and surrounded by beautiful views of the grounds. You’ll be able to find this in custom games, the PCC Tour and our upcoming Golden Decade Tournament.
Camera improvements ensuring that the focus is more on players during gameplay.
Improved transition effects from pot to player stack.
Improvements for hi-vis cards in player bar/list.
Reduction in the wait time before a tournament game starts from 5 minutes to 1 minute.
Reintroduction of the intro video.
Improvements to the speed of presentation of leaderboard information.
Improvements to timings across the game, with the aim of optimising game speed.
Improvements to messages in relation to network issues.
Fix for an issue that caused an overheat message to show on XB.
Welcome to the newest Poker Club update. Update 1.80.3 includes:

notes.title: UX/UI changes to the bottom bar and player list

items.text: We've overhauled the core heads-up display, focusing on the player list and community cards. These changes focus on improving the clarity of the game and helping to build an immersive, exciting experience.
You can now generate a code allowing players to directly join your game or tournament, without the need for them to be on your friend list.
Keep up to date with all of the latest Poker Club news without ever having to leave your game, with a brand new scrolling news bar. (Convenient we know!)
2021 is set to be an amazing year for Poker Club! Make sure to check out our most recent blog post to see what else is coming up.
We'll see you soon with more details on the next update!

An update is now available to download for Poker Club on PC and Xbox platforms. This update brings PC and Xbox platforms in line with PlayStation platforms. Update 1.56 on PC and 1.58 on Xbox platforms include:
Private multi-table tournaments.
Improvements and clarification of trophies
Brand new ring reward sequence
As well as this update, we will also be making some changes to the AI across all platforms in the coming weeks. These changes include:

Behaviour - Based on internal data and community feedback we are making some key tweaks to AI behaviour. This change is primarily focused on the aggressive behaviours of ‘maniacs’ and will also reduce the frequency with which a ‘nit’ will attempt to steal blinds.

Labelling - AI labels will now represent the strategy that AI is playing with at the current table, rather than being formed from how it has played in all of its previous games. This will allow you to make more strategic predictions around how it is going to play.

Statistics - Stats for particular AI players will now only show their history from playing with their current label. E.g. if TwinnyWinTwin is a ‘donkey’ at the current table, you will be able to see how he performed historically as a ‘donkey’ at other tables.
We'll be releasing a Dev Diary with more info on how the AI plays in the near future, so watch this space.

Future Updates

This will be the last update before the new year, as our team prepare to take a break for the holidays. We’ll still be monitoring feedback and staying in touch on Discord, just a little less often than usual. We will also be asking for feedback on specific community-raised issues over on Discord during the holidays. If you haven't already joined us on Discord but would like to contribute your feedback, you can join the Poker Club server. You can also continue to report any issues using our Player Feedback Form, and every response will be picked up in January. All feedback is greatly appreciated and will help to feed into and prioritise further updates as we return in the new year. If you'd like more details on our future plans, we've shared more details in our December Status Update.

We had initially hoped to include a fix for exiting the game on PC as part of 1.19, but this will now be included in the next update. Thank you for your understanding as we work through community feedback as quickly as we can, we’re incredibly grateful for every report that we receive.
Scheduled Server Maintenance 09/12/2020

Following today’s release of Update 1.19 for PC and Xbox platforms, we are carrying out scheduled server maintenance tomorrow across all platforms, between 10am – 2pm GMT / 5am – 9am PST. There will be intermittent disruption during this time as we push server updates live.
Further details of our upcoming plans are available in our December Status Update.
Hi everyone,

Since our launch across PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X, we’ve been completely overwhelmed by community support and passion for Poker Club. It has been a joy to experience your wins, jump into your streams and celebrate our shared love for the game of poker together.

Today we’d like to share an update on server maintenance, improvements that are coming in future game updates and our longer-term plans for the future of Poker Club. Live development cycles mean that timelines can change, but we would still like to keep you up to date with our plans. Today we shared a full breakdown of our current plans and things that we're working on and looking into. You can check the post out over on our Dev Diary:
DEV DIARY DECEMBER 1ST UPDATE >>
Keep reading for a quick summary!
DECEMBER 1ST SERVER MAINTENANCE
Status: Complete and fixes are now live across all platforms.
Changes to PCC Tour tournament registration to reduce “log-in rejected” errors
Changes to AI betting and bluffing behaviours
Changes to general gameplay pacing
General optimisation and stability improvements

Following today’s server maintenance, a series of community-led changes have now been implemented across all platforms. These changes include improvements to AI behaviour and game pacing, which are two areas that we plan to monitor and refine based on community feedback. Getting both of these things right is incredibly important to us and we’re committed to listening, learning and taking the time to make meaningful changes.
UPDATE 1.03
Status: Coming soon
